The Planner failed to verify this absence against the gathered evidence and instead hallucinated or assumed the presence of gin, leading to the wrong final answer that both drinks contain gin. This is a classic case of misinterpretation of search results and overgeneralization, where the agent inserted an unsupported ingredient into its understanding.
